We got three templates. Need the one that when applied to target gives the precursors list from earlier. The precursors list were three SMILES (the product?). Actually the precursors list from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1 were those three SMILES (the product). Wait earlier answer: list of lists with SMILES strings. Those SMILES are the product? They contain the alkene and carboxylic acid, no P. So the template applied to target (product) gave precursors (phosphonate and aldehyde). So the template we need is the one that maps product to reactants (reverse). The search result includes templates with mapped_rxn and reactant_smiles (precursors) and product_smiles (product). The first template (reaction_id 1914389) has product_smiles matching our product? Let's compare product_smiles from first template: '[CH3:1]/[C:2](=[CH:3]/[C@H:4]1[O:5][C@@H:6]([CH2:7]/[CH:8]=[CH:9]/[CH:10]=[CH:11]/[C:12](=[O:13])[OH:14])[CH2:15][C@H:16]([O:17][Si:18]([CH3:19])([CH3:20])[C:21]([CH3:22])([CH3:23])[CH3:24])[C@H:25]1[CH3:26])[CH2:27][OH:28]'

Our product SMILES is "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". This matches pattern: CH3? Actually product has terminal CH2OH not CH3. The template product has CH2OH? It ends with [CH2:27][OH:28] which is CH2OH. Good. Also has Si protecting group. So likely first template matches.

Thus we need to return mapped_rxn from that template and template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The template_id likely is reaction_id? Or maybe template_id is the integer ID used for search. The problem statement: "template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash)". In search results, each entry has 'reaction_id' and 'template_hash'. The template_id likely is reaction_id? Or maybe there is separate template_id field not shown. But we have reaction_id. We'll assume template_id = reaction_id.

Thus we will output mapped_rxn from first entry and template_id = 1914389.

Let's extract mapped_rxn string from first entry: It's long. Provided in result: 

'mapped_rxn': 'O=[CH:8][CH2:7][C@@H:6]1[O:5][C@H:4](/[CH:3]=[C:2](/[CH3:1])[CH2:27][OH:28])[C@H:25]([CH3:26])[C@@H:16]([O:17][Si:18]([CH3:19])([CH3:20])[C:21]([CH3:22])([CH3:23])[CH3:24])[CH2:15]1.CCOP(=O)(OCC)[CH2:9]/[CH:10]=[CH:11]/[C:12](=[O:13])[O:14]CC>>[CH3:1]/[C:2](=[CH:3]/[C@H:4]1[O:5][C@@H:6]([CH2:7]/[CH:8]=[CH:9]/[CH:10]=[CH:11]/[C:12](=[O:13])[OH:14])[CH2:15][C@H:16]([O:17][Si:18]([CH3:19])([CH3:20])[C:21]([CH3:22])([CH3:23])[CH3:24])[C@H:25]1[CH3:26])[CH2:27][OH:28]'
